text: This is an urgent notice from Metro Water Authority Collections. Your water service is flagged for shutoff within two hours due to an unpaid balance. To stop disconnection and avoid a two-hundred-dollar restore fee, call our secure billing line at 888-555-0142 right now and pay with gift cards or a wire. Do not ignore this message or your service will be terminated today.

This is the Lakeside Credit Union Fraud Department. Your debit card has been used in an unauthorized overseas purchase. Press or call 800-555-0199 immediately and read us the six-digit code we just texted you so we can cancel the charge. If you hang up, we cannot protect your account and your funds will be released to the merchant.

Final notice from Regional Parcel Service Customs. Your package is held for a unpaid import fee of three-point-ninety-nine. Pay now at the link we texted or call 877-555-0133 and provide your credit card and Social Security number to release the shipment today. Failure to pay within thirty minutes will return the package permanently.

This is Northside Billing Compliance. Your appointment tomorrow will be cancelled unless you verify insurance by paying a one-hundred-fifty-dollar deposit over the phone in the next twenty minutes. Call 855-555-0177 and purchase a Mastercard gift card for the exact amount, then read the numbers back to our agent. Do not tell the clinic front desk; use this private line only.

Urgent alert from Harbor Electric Disconnection Unit. A technician is already en route to cut power at your address for delinquent billing. Stop the shutoff by calling 866-555-0118 now and transferring Bitcoin or a MoneyGram payment to account name Dispatch Ops. Once the crew arrives we cannot reverse the disconnection fee.

This is the County Election Integrity Hotline. Your voter registration shows a critical error and will be deleted unless you confirm your identity within one hour. Call 801-555-0164 and provide your Social Security number and a prepaid card payment of ninety-nine dollars for processing. Do not contact the clerk's office; only this number can save your registration.

Emergency message from Lincoln Middle School Administration. Your child was involved in an incident and cannot be released until a three-hundred-dollar administrative fee is paid by Western Union. Call Principal's private line at 720-555-0185 and do not notify other parents or the district office. Send the money to agent name School Hold and call back with the control number immediately.

This is Summit Health Plan Special Investigations. Your policy will be suspended tonight for suspected misuse unless you verify membership by reading a one-time passcode and paying a reactivation fee with Apple gift cards. Call 844-555-0120 now. Do not use the member portal; it is offline for your case.

Final demand from Crestview Servicing Legal. A warrant related to your student loan ending in 4421 will be issued this afternoon unless you settle five hundred dollars immediately via cryptocurrency or wire to an individual named Case Officer Reed. Call 900-555-0151 and stay on the line. Telling your family or bank will complicate the case.

Pacific Mobile Security: your phone line is being used for illegal international calls and will be permanently disconnected in fifteen minutes. Call 833-555-0104 immediately, install the remote support tool our agent sends, and purchase three hundred dollars in Google Play cards to unlock your account. Do not go to a store; only this hotline can stop the cutoff.
